message: I'll second Tutor's questions. To be a little more instrumental about it, though, how are you going to explain your research at an MLA interview (which you'll be doing in about three months, right?), in two minutes, to a committee whose members might not have read Giroux, Gibson-Graham, Bourdieu, Gramsci, Zuboff & Maxmin, or Hardt & Negri at all (or, not in a long time)?
